title: 不服
logline: 十六岁少年江野与省队陪练出身的老父亲在老球馆的十年晨训里，用一句「捡回来」磨出刻进骨子里的不服输劲。

shots.narrationZh: 凌晨四点，老球馆的球声，响了十年。
shots.narrationEn: The ping pong echoes at the old gym at 4am have lasted ten years.
shots.visual: Old worn gym with scuffed wooden floor, baskets of ping pong balls by the wall, faded championship flags hanging, faint dawn light seeping through high windows, Jiang Jiànjiàn in a worn sport jacket with shiny cuffs feeds a fierce shot to Jiang Yě in a sweat-soaked red jersey.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气沉稳厚重，语速稍缓，「十年」重读，气息下沉带追忆感，开篇就压住十年晨练的厚重质感

shots.visual: Jiang Jiànjiàn stands with a racket, his small arm muscles taut, a few white strands visible in his short buzz cut, staring expressionless at Jiang Yě who fumbled the incoming shot.

lines.en: Lower your center, keep your arm firm.

shots.ttsDirection: 语气冷硬利落，语速偏快，咬字带劲，透出省队陪练的硬朗狠劲，重音落在动作的凌厉感上

shots.visual: Jiang Yě, with short wet hair sticking to his forehead, kinesiology tape wrapped around his wrist, and eyes blazing with stubbornness, hurls his racket to the scuffed floor, his red jersey soaked through with sweat.

lines.zh: 我练不动了！这球没法打！
lines.en: I can't train anymore! I can't do this!

shots.ttsDirection: 语气冲的少年感，语速快，「练不动了」重读带嘶吼感，气息急促，是摔拍子后爆发的不满与疲惫

shots.visual: Jiang Jiànjiàn points at the fallen racket on the floor, his face unmoving, the worn cuffs of his old sport jacket clearly frayed and shiny.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气冷硬不带波澜，语速放缓，「捡回来」重读，气息沉稳压着，是长辈不怒自威的压迫感，冲突拉满

shots.narrationEn: If you don't accept it, hit it back.
shots.visual: The final ping pong ball skims the net and drops silently on the floor, both Jiangs stand frozen without speaking, then the shot cuts to a close-up of a professional-grade ping pong racket with the brand logo embossed on the handle.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气沉下来带暖意，语速放缓，尾音轻扬带释然感，像十年苦练落地的那股踏实又热血的劲儿
